description: Use when you keep a KYB/LEI register and need what changed since your last run: legal-entity records created, lapsed. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /lei/changes, $0.02 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

country.description: Optional ISO country of the legal address, e.g. DE

page.description: Page of the newest-first list, default 1

since.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD, at most 400 days back; records last updated on or after it

status.description: Optional registration status: ISSUED, LAPSED, ANNULLED, PENDING_TRANSFER, PENDING_ARCHIVAL, DUPLICATE, RETIRED, MERGED

name: lei_changes
title: Lei changes
